---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest something new for MPx
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What do you want?
A clear, short description of the feature.

## Why?
What problem does it solve for you? What do you do today without it?

## How would it work?
If you have an idea — where in the app would it live, what would it look like? A sketch or a screenshot of another app doing it well helps.

## Alternatives
Is there another way to do this already, or a simpler version of the idea?

## Extra context
Anything else that helps decide if this fits MPx.
